svg.aria-label: A mail-sorting machine on a plate fenced on three sides with one gate. An RFP being drafted sits in the hopper; the router cuts it into six cards. Requirements, evaluation, security and schedule run down short chutes into bins beside four agent workstations inside the fence. Market research and pricing run to the gate, where two stamping heads shear off their red RFP number, budget and evaluation-plan tabs, keep them inside, and stamp capability search on what leaves. A return tray brings options back to a single desk marked human decides.
